newsitem.title: USA: Olympic raises price of purchase offer.
newsitem.headline: Olympic raises price of purchase offer.

text.p: Olympic Financial Ltd said Thursday it amended its offer to buy all of its outstanding 13 percent senior notes due 2000 to increase the purchase price to $1,142.50 from $1,137.50 for each $1,000 principal amount.

The offer remains subject to certain conditions, including completion of financing. The amended offer was mailed Thursday to record holders of the senior notes as of the close of business on February 19, 1997.
The offer and related consent solicitation previously were extended and will expire on March 6, unless further extended.
